summary: The v2 preview is bound to the frozen manuscript. Actual inspection of pages 1 and 4 supports readable hierarchy and faithful source notation within that coverage. It does not establish whole-document visual quality, HTML rendering, PDF tagging, or accessibility conformance.

checks.method: Recomputed canonical snapshot and manuscript hashes, F27 manifest hash, and all twelve listed file hashes and byte counts.
checks.observation: Every comparison matched; the manifest manuscript digest equals this round's inspected Markdown digest.

checks.method: Viewed both supplied PNG pages with view_image and compared their text and formulas with frozen Markdown.
checks.observation: Page 1 visibly distinguishes title, section headings, and body. Page 4 retains subtraction signs, inequalities, labels (1)–(3), and the opening sum-of-squares chain without visible clipping. ASCII binom, underscores, and source-style identifiers remain readable rather than fully typeset mathematics.
